p_codes.P210: Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames and other ignition sources. No smoking.
p_codes.P220: Keep away from clothing and other combustible materials.
p_codes.P223: Do not allow contact with water.
p_codes.P243: Take action to prevent static discharges.
p_codes.P280: Wear protective gloves/protective clothing/eye protection/face protection.
p_codes.P301+P310: IF SWALLOWED: Immediately call a POISON CENTER/doctor.
p_codes.P301+P330+P331: IF SWALLOWED: Rinse mouth. Do NOT induce vomiting.
p_codes.P303+P361+P353: IF ON SKIN (or hair): Take off immediately all contaminated clothing. Rinse skin with water/shower.
p_codes.P304+P340: IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing.
p_codes.P305+P351+P338: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.
